_meta.title: CompilerDesignV2 — AST Node & Symbol Table Reference
_meta.description: Machine-readable reference documenting every surviving AST node: its C++ type, nodeType string, semanticMeaning pattern, nodeValue pattern, stEntry fields set by SymTabCreationVisitor, and children layout. Also tracks design decisions and code evolution. Keep this file updated as the compiler evolves.

field_glossary.nodeType: String set at construction by the parser; matches the C++ class name of the node (e.g. 'fparams', 'param'). Used for type-checking children: child->nodeType == 'fparams'.
field_glossary.semanticMeaning: String set at construction; describes the structural role this node plays within its parent's grammar production. Often equals nodeType but can differ (e.g. a classNode has semanticMeaning='classdecl'). Used when scanning a parent's children by role: child->semanticMeaning == 'funchead'.
field_glossary.nodeValue: Raw token text from the source file. Only meaningful on LEAF nodes (idNode, intNode, floatnumNode, typeNode, addopNode, etc.). Empty string on interior nodes.

stEntry.name: The declared identifier string assembled from a descendant id leaf's nodeValue. Set by SymTabCreationVisitor.
stEntry.kind: Semantic category string. Values: 'class' | 'function' | 'function head' | 'function body' | 'implementation' | 'variable' | 'attribute' | 'parameter'.
stEntry.type: Declared type or return type string (e.g. 'integer', 'float', 'MyClass', 'void'). For classNode, concatenated inherited class names.
stEntry.visibility: 'public' or 'private'. Only set on class member entries (attributedeclfamNode, funcdeclfamNode).
stEntry.hasLink: Boolean. True when this entry owns a nested scope.
stEntry.link: Pointer to a std::map<string, symbolTableEntry*> representing the scope owned by this entry. Null when hasLink=false.

field_glossary.stMap: The map that lives directly on a node object (node::stMap). Scoped nodes (classNode, funcNode, implNode, funcbodyNode, fparamsNode) populate their own stMap and then point stEntry.link at it.

stEntry.notes: stEntry is unused. The global symbol table lives in startNode.stMap.

startNode.stMap: Global symbol table. Keys are class names and free-function names. Values point to classNode.stEntry or funcNode.stEntry.
startNode.visitor_sets: SymTabCreationVisitor::visit(startNode) populates stMap from children. Also validates: every class declaration has an implementation, no duplicate class declarations, impl matches a declared class.

stEntry.name: class identifier (e.g. 'Animal')
stEntry.type: concatenated inherited class names from isalist (empty if no inheritance)

classNode.stMap: Members of the class. Keys = member names. Values = attributedeclfamNode.stEntry or funcdeclfamNode.stEntry pointers.

children.role: isalist — inherited classes (absent / epsilon if no base classes)

classNode.visitor_sets: SymTabCreationVisitor::visit(classNode): sets kind/name/hasLink/link, populates stMap from attributedecl and funcdecl children. Duplicate member names emit spdlog::error.
classNode.notes: passAlong from classdeclNode — C++ type changes to classNode, semanticMeaning stays 'classdecl'.

stEntry.name: class name this impl belongs to (e.g. 'Animal')

implNode.stMap: Function entries for this implementation block. Keys = method names. Values = funcheadNode.stEntry pointers (kind='function').

children.role: method signature (class id, method id, params, returntype)

implNode.visitor_sets: SymTabCreationVisitor::visit(implNode): sets kind/name/hasLink/link. Builds a funcEntry from funcheadNode, merges localvardecls from reptimpldef3 into funcEntry.link, stores in stMap[funcName].
implNode.notes: passAlong from impldefNode. startNode.visit() cross-checks each implNode against its classNode declaration: validates return type, param names/types, function name existence. Merges impl entries into the class's stMap.

stEntry.name: function name (e.g. 'main', 'sort')
stEntry.type: return type string (e.g. 'integer', 'void')

funcNode.stMap: Union of funcheadNode.stEntry.link (params) and funcbodyNode.stEntry.link (locals). Keys = param/local names.
funcNode.visitor_sets: SymTabCreationVisitor::visit(funcNode): kind='function', name/type from funcheadNode.stEntry, stMap = merge of funchead.link + funcbody.link.
funcNode.notes: Also visit(funcdefNode) runs on the same node (funcdef survives as funcNode via passalong). Same logic in both — funcNode is the surviving type.

stEntry.name: function name (first idNode child). 'constructor' if no id child found.
stEntry.type: return type from returntypeNode/voidNode child nodeValue
stEntry.link: points to funcparams child node's stMap (the fparamsNode equivalent)

funcheadNode.stMap: Not directly populated — link points to funcparams child's stMap.
funcheadNode.visitor_sets: SymTabCreationVisitor::visit(funcheadNode): scans direct children for first id (name), returntype, funcparams (link). Constructors detected by empty name.
funcheadNode.notes: Children are epsilon-terminated so indices are variable. Use semanticMeaning to identify children, not fixed indices.

stEntry.name: copied from parent funcNode.stEntry.name after merge

funcbodyNode.stMap: Local variable declarations. Keys = local variable names. Values = localvardeclNode.stEntry pointers.

children.role: local declarations and statements in source order

funcbodyNode.visitor_sets: SymTabCreationVisitor::visit(funcbodyNode): collects vardecl children into stMap. Duplicate local names emit spdlog::error.

stEntry.name: function name
stEntry.type: return type
stEntry.link: points to fparams stMap from funcdeclNode child

funcdeclfamNode.visitor_sets: SymTabCreationVisitor::visit(funcdeclfamNode): reads visibility from visibilityNode child, then digs into funcdeclNode grandchildren for id/returntype/funcparams.
funcdeclfamNode.notes: Appears as children of classNode. Its stEntry is what classNode.stMap stores under the function name.

stEntry.name: function name (recursive search via get('id', head))
stEntry.type: return type (recursive search via get('returntype', head))

children.notes: epsilon-terminated; id absent for constructors, returntype absent for constructors

funcdeclNode.notes: Lives inside funcdeclfamNode inside a classNode body.

stEntry.name: attribute name (from vardecl child stEntry.name)
stEntry.type: attribute type (from vardecl child stEntry.type)

attributedeclfamNode.visitor_sets: SymTabCreationVisitor::visit(attributedeclfamNode): kind='attribute', name/type from vardecl child stEntry, visibility from visibilityNode child nodeValue.
attributedeclfamNode.notes: Its stEntry is what classNode.stMap stores under the attribute name.

stEntry.name: attribute name via get('id', head)
stEntry.type: attribute type via get('type', head)

stEntry.notes: stEntry unused — the table lives in stMap.

fparamsNode.stMap: Parameter table. Keys = parameter names. Values = paramNode.stEntry pointers.
fparamsNode.visitor_sets: SymTabCreationVisitor::visit(fparamsNode): iterates paramNode children, inserts stEntry pointers into stMap. Duplicate param names emit spdlog::error.

stEntry.name: parameter name via get('id', head)
stEntry.type: parameter type via get('type', head)

paramNode.semantic_check_notes: SemanticCheckingVisitor::visit(paramNode) is partially implemented — checks children count == 2 but type comparison logic is incomplete.

stEntry.name: variable name via get('id', head)
stEntry.type: variable type via get('type', head)

children.role: dimension list (absent if no array dims)

stEntry.notes: Unused — visitor reads children directly from implNode visitor.

stEntry.type: TO BE SET during semantic checking (resolved LHS type for type propagation)

reptstatement4Node.construction_note: makeBinarySubTree mode 1: pops expr(top), assign(middle, absorbed), variable(bottom). Children = {variable, expr}.
reptstatement4Node.semantic_check_notes: SemanticCheckingVisitor::visit(reptstatement4Node) partially implemented: validates binary structure, captures left/right children but does not yet resolve or compare types.

stEntry.type: TO BE SET during semantic checking (resolved return type)

children.role: else branch (empty children if no else)

stEntry.type: TO BE SET during semantic checking (resolved type of the member access result)

dotNode.construction_note: makeBinarySubTree mode 0: pops member(top), object(bottom). children[0]=member, children[1]=object.
dotNode.semantic_check_notes: To resolve: look up children[1]'s type in the global stMap to get the class entry, then look up children[0]'s name in that class's stMap.

stEntry.notes: Unused. conditionNode IS the relexpr — it passAlongs directly.

children.role: else-branch statements (empty children = no else clause)

stEntry.type: TO BE SET during semantic checking (resolved expression type)
stEntry.notes: All other fields unused. Type should be propagated up from child nodes.

symbol_table_lookup_patterns.description: Common patterns for resolving identifiers during SemanticCheckingVisitor passes.
symbol_table_lookup_patterns.global_lookup: root->stMap[name] — finds a class or free function by name.
symbol_table_lookup_patterns.class_member_lookup: root->stMap[className]->link->count(memberName) — checks if a class has a member.
symbol_table_lookup_patterns.function_param_local_lookup: root->stMap[funcName]->link->count(varName) — checks params/locals of a free function.
symbol_table_lookup_patterns.class_method_param_local_lookup: root->stMap[className]->link->at(methodName)->link->count(varName) — checks params/locals of a class method.
symbol_table_lookup_patterns.type_propagation_rule: Set node->stEntry.type bottom-up. Leaf intNode -> 'integer', floatnumNode -> 'float', typeNode -> nodeValue. For operators: if both operands are same type, result is that type; mixed integer/float should resolve to float or emit error per language rules.
symbol_table_lookup_patterns.variable_resolution_rule: For reptvariable2andidNode: read children[0] (idNode) nodeValue as the name. Look up in innermost scope first (local stMap), then enclosing function stMap (via root), then class stMap. The resolved stEntry.type becomes this node's stEntry.type.
symbol_table_lookup_patterns.function_call_resolution_rule: For aparamsandidNode: read children[0] (idNode) nodeValue as function name. Look up in root->stMap or current class stMap. Verify argument count and types match declared parameters. Set stEntry.type = declared return type.
symbol_table_lookup_patterns.dot_resolution_rule: For dotNode: resolve children[1] (object) type -> look up that class in root->stMap -> look up children[0] (member/method name) in that class's link. Set stEntry.type = member type or method return type.

semantic_checks_status.description: Current implementation status of semantic checks as of last update.
implemented_in_SymTabCreationVisitor: Duplicate attribute declarations within a class (classNode)
Duplicate function declarations within a class (classNode)
Duplicate parameter names within a function (fparamsNode)
Duplicate local variable declarations within a function body (funcbodyNode)
Function implemented but not declared in class (startNode impl merge)
Return type mismatch between declaration and implementation (startNode impl merge)

partially_implemented_in_SemanticCheckin: reptstatement4Node: binary structure validated; LHS/RHS captured but types not yet compared
floatnumNode: logs debug only; stEntry.type not yet set to 'float'
paramNode: children count validated; type comparison logic incomplete (syntax error in code)

Variable reference resolution (reptvariable2andidNode — look up in scoped stMaps)
Return expression type vs function return type check (freturnstatementNode)
Array index type must be integer (indiceNode)

passalong_table.description: When a passAlong action fires, the original C++ type is deleted and a new one is created. The semanticMeaning is preserved. Visitor dispatch is by C++ type so always write visit() for the SURVIVING type.

construction_rules.makeBinarySubTree_mode0_dot: Pops member(top) and object(bottom). children = {member, object}. children[0]=member(RHS), children[1]=object(LHS).
construction_rules.makeBinarySubTree_mode1_assign: Pops expr(top), assign(middle, absorbed into node), variable(bottom). children = {variable, expr}. children[0]=LHS, children[1]=RHS.
construction_rules.makeBinarySubTreeWithHead_statements: write/read/return/if/while: pops count nodes, first (keyword leaf) is absorbed via copyNode into the new node type. Keyword leaf does NOT appear as a child. Remaining nodes become children in push order.
